thread:
alex: quick share — ran mixed-seq perf sweep on H100 with continuous batching + kv_cache. p95 jumped badly when short+long interleave. selector kept picking vect-fused-v3; launch overhead ballooned.
priya: can you paste the loadgen command and a tiny profile snippet? is autotune=on?
alex: autotune=on. repro: 
```
./loadgen --model rwlm-7b --batch_size 64 --seq_dist "mix:70/30:32/1024" --kv_cache=true --continuous_batching=true
```
perf excerpt: launch 0.9ms -> 3.4ms, many micro-batches chose vect-fused-v3.
tom: saw same locally. mixed-case p95 token ~28ms vs baseline all-long ~12ms. throughput down ~20%. kv_hit_rate ~0.62.
perf-bot: profiling snippet (trimmed):
```
[H100] micro-launch (vect-fused-v3) setup_time=3.1ms, exec_time_per_token=0.28ms
[H100] micro-launch (streamed-attn) setup_time=0.6ms, exec_time_per_token=0.35ms
batch=64, avg_seq=320, avg_micro_batch=8
```
priya: that fits. vect-fused wins asymptotically but high setup cost punishes lots of small micro-launches from continuous batching.
liang: root cause: kernel-scoring only considers per-request FLOPs and seq_len; it ignores scheduler-derived micro-batch counts and kv dynamics. For mixed seq we get many micro-launches and vect-fused becomes expensive.
alex: quick hack: I added a kv-weighted launch penalty: penalty = launch_cost * (1 + 0.8*(1 - kv_hit_rate)). prevented vect-fused picks in mixed runs and lowered p95 in my test.
liam: can you share A/B numbers? we need a clear perf uplift without regressing pure-long cases.
perf-bot: A/B where streamed-attn forced for mixed workload: p95 token 28ms -> 14ms, throughput +18%. pure-long: 12.0ms -> 12.6ms (+5%).
liang: proposed change to autotuner scoring:
```
# score = launch_cost * alpha + exec_cost * expected_tokens
# alpha = 1 + kv_penalty * (1 - kv_hit_rate)
# expected_tokens = avg_seq * expected_micro_batches
```
expected_micro_batches computed from scheduler target_micro_batch_size + small jitter margin. use 1m moving averages for avg_seq and kv_hit_rate.
priya: make it a config flag (opt-in=false) for one release, surface kernel choice reason in console per-route. also add tests simulating seq mixes+kv toggles.
alex: i'll open a PR with the heuristic + perf test. PR will log per-selection features: avg_seq, batch_depth, kv_hit_rate, hw_type, prev_kernel.
tom: i'll run stress across H100/A100 and report. liam/infra, can you add logging hook for selection features?
deploy-bot: rollout plan: enable on 10% canary nodes for routes tagged low-latency, monitor p95 and throughput; auto-rollback if p95 regresses >8% for 5m.
liang: later we can train an ML tuner on these logged features. for now the heuristic should be lightweight.
priya: action items: alex PR, liam infra logging, tom perf sweep, canary rollout. i'll draft console notes explaining kernel-choice signal.
alex: PR #4215 incoming; will paste perf graphs once CI finishes. :thumbsup:
